item.title: President Lee: "Peace on the Korean Peninsula Is a Core Task for World Peace... Will Fulfill Responsibility Through Wartime Operational Control Reversion" (李대통령 “한반도 평화, 세계 평화의 핵심 과제… 전작권 환수로 책임 다할 것”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Peace on the Korean Peninsula Is a Core Task for World Peace... Will Fulfill Responsibility Through Wartime Operational Control Reversion" (李대통령 “한반도 평화, 세계 평화의 핵심 과제… 전작권 환수로 책임 다할 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 2nd, "Peace on the Korean Peninsula is not just our own issue; it is a core task for stability in Northeast Asia at close range and world peace at large," adding, "As a direct party to this weighty task, I will fulfill that responsibility through the reversion of wartime operational control." President Lee had also emphasized the transition of wartime operational control last month, right after the reduction of South Korea-U.S. joint exercises, saying, "The reversion within my term must be pursued without disruption according to the original government plan." (이재명 대통령은 2일 “한반도 평화는 우리들만의 일이 아니고 가까이는 동북아 안정, 멀리는 세계 평화의 핵심 과제”라며 “이 막중한 과제의 직접 당사자로서 전시작전권 환수를 통해 그 책임을 다할 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 한미 연합 훈련 축소 직후에도 “임기 내 환수를 당초 정부의 계획에 따라 차질 없이 추진해 나가야 한다”면서 전작권 전환을 강조했었다.)

At the Americas regional meeting of the Democratic Peace and Unification Advisory Council held at the Inspire Resort in Incheon that day, President Lee said regarding inter-Korean relations, "As President Trump's decision has created even a slight possibility for change in the situation on the Korean Peninsula, we must create the conditions for constructive discussions to build trust and resume dialogue between North Korea and the United States." (이 대통령은 이날 인천 인스파이어 리조트에서 열린 민주평화통일자문회의(민주평통) 미주지역 회의에서 남북 관계와 관련해 “트럼프 대통령의 결단으로 한반도 정세에 그 변화 가능성이 조금이나마 생긴 만큼, 북미 간에 신뢰 구축과 대화 재개를 위한 건설적인 논의의 여건을 우리가 만들어 나가야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee made these remarks while saying, "The wall built over more than 80 years (between the two Koreas) will not collapse just because we wait. That is why we must take action." His comments came amid U.S. President Donald Trump's recent remarks expressing willingness to meet North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un within the year. (이 대통령은 “(남북 간) 80년 넘게 쌓인 벽이 기다린다고 허물어지지 않는다. 그래서 우리가 움직여야 한다”면서 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령의 발언은 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령이 최근 북한 김정은 국무위원장과 연내에 만날 것이라며 미북 대화 의지를 밝히고 있는 가운데 나왔다.)

When President Trump ordered a significant reduction in South Korea-U.S. joint exercises last month, citing his "very good relationship with Kim Jong-un," President Lee had also expressed "respect for that decision." However, North Korea, through a statement by a Foreign Ministry spokesperson late last month, said, "There is not the slightest change in our policy toward the United States to respond with maximum strength to the end against America's unchanging hostile policy." (지난달 트럼프 대통령이 “김정은과 매우 좋은 관계를 맺고 있다”며 한미 연합 훈련 대폭 축소를 지시했을 때도 이 대통령은 “그 결단에 경의를 표한다”고 했었다. 다만 북한은 지난달 말 외무성 대변인 담화를 통해 “미국의 변함없는 적대시 정책에 끝까지 최강경으로 대응하려는 우리 대미 정책에는 추호의 변화도 없다”고 했다.)

That day, President Lee said, "The two Koreas, which should be closest to each other, remain completely and utterly severed," adding, "It is truly unfortunate and a harsh reality that must be changed that we are wasting the strength needed to move forward together on confrontation and rivalry." He continued, "We must institutionalize and structurally entrench peace," and "So that tensions do not recur with shifts in domestic politics or fluctuations in the international situation, we must surely transform the armistice system premised on confrontation and rivalry into a peace system that can serve as the foundation for cooperation and prosperity." (이날 이 대통령은 “가장 가까워야 할 남과 북은 여전히 그리고 완전히 끊겨 있다”며 “함께 나아갈 수 있는 힘을 맞서는 데, 대결하는 데 낭비하고 있는 건 참으로 불행하고 반드시 바꿔야 할 참혹한 현실”이라고 했다. 이어 “평화를 제도, 구조로 정착시켜 나가야 한다”며 “국내 정치의 변화나 국제 정세의 부침에 따라 긴장이 다시는 되풀이되지 않도록 대립과 대결을 전제로 한 정전 체제를 협력과 번영의 기반이 될 평화 체제로 반드시 바꾸어 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Trying to seize the initiative in merger talks? Cho Kuk attacks President Lee and Democratic Party day after day (합당 협상 주도권 쥐려는 건가… 조국, 연일 李대통령·민주당 때리기)
item.description:
Former Cho Kuk Innovation Party leader Cho Kuk has been criticizing the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party of Korea day after day. In particular, he even mentioned President Lee Jae-myung's trial, saying "the likelihood of a guilty verdict is high." As controversy grew, the former leader Cho described it as a "red team role for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration" and called it "loyal advice." However, within the Democratic Party, there are murmurs that "it only looks like an attempt to seize the upper hand during the initial phase of merger discussions." <<> On the 2nd, former leader Cho wrote on Facebook about the tax reform plan the government passed at a cabinet meeting the previous day, saying, "The Democratic Party has claimed to be the 'party of the middle class and ordinary people,' but this time, what the Democratic Party and the government protected was the interests of the top 1%." Initially, the government sought to lower the comprehensive real estate tax basic deduction for non-resident single-home owners from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won, but withdrew the plan after public sentiment turned negative. Former leader Cho said, "This 'U-turn' could cost them the hearts of the people who gave votes (to the Democratic Party)." <<> The previous day, former leader Cho also said, "If they push through with the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee, they will inevitably face political and legal ruin." This was his view that the authority to withdraw prosecutions should not be included in the special counsel bill on fabricated indictments pushed by the pro-Lee faction. He added, "The likelihood of a guilty verdict in the second trial for spreading false information, which will resume after President Lee's term, is very high," and "the proper approach on this matter is to revise the law on spreading false information." Former leader Cho had supported the special counsel bill when the Democratic Party proposed it in June before the local elections, which granted the special counsel the power to withdraw prosecutions, but this time he opposed it. <<> The Democratic Party immediately pushed back. Park Sun-won, a pro-Lee supreme council member, said at a party meeting that day, "Former leader Cho's remarks are deeply regrettable," adding, "This cannot be the language of a comrade; it can only be called ingratitude." He cited President Lee Jae-myung's pardon and reinstatement of former leader Cho, as well as the recent appointment of a former Cho Kuk Innovation Party lawmaker as the senior presidential secretary for AI future planning at the presidential office. In response, former leader Cho said at a lecture in South Jeolla's Gwangju that day, "Blindly saying 'you're doing great' is what actually ruins President Lee and the administration," adding, "What is wrong should be called wrong, and what needs to be corrected should be corrected." As for the assessment of being "anti-Lee," he said, "I just laugh it off." <<> However, as former leader Cho escalates the intensity of his criticism, there are voices within the Democratic Party saying, "This is a power play to avoid being sidelined in the merger discussions." Ahead of the June elections, the Democratic Party and the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had declared merger talks but postponed them due to opposition from the pro-Lee faction within the Democratic Party. Since then, former leader Cho ran in the by-election for Pyeongtaek Gap, where the Democratic Party fielded former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, and both ended up losing. <<> Since that time, there have been murmurs within the Cho Kuk Innovation Party that "former leader Cho, having experienced the collapse of the merger and his failure to re-enter the National Assembly, will change." Then, after Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok launched a "grand unity promotion task force" immediately after taking office and ordered discussions on solidarity and merger with the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, former leader Cho's rhetoric grew stronger. An official from the Cho Kuk Innovation Party said, "The core of those opposing the merger is Representative Kim and the pro-Lee faction," adding, "This time, we won't be pushed around by the Democratic Party." Former leader Cho also targeted Representative Kim that day, saying, "The person who attacked me with the false claim that 'former Representative Jung Chung-rae and I had a secret deal—him for party leadership and me for the presidency—during the merger talks has never apologized," adding, "I don't know what there is to discuss without resolving that issue first." Within the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, some have argued that "an absorption-style merger as the Democratic Party wants is absolutely impossible," and that a merger can only happen if proper shares are secured ahead of the 2028 general election. <<> The two parties are already engaged in a war of nerves. In particular, within the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Representative Kim Min-seok's recent appointment of former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam—who ran against former leader Cho in Pyeongtaek Gap—as senior vice chair of the policy committee has drawn reactions like, "They say they want to discuss unity, but what is this supposed to mean?" Cho Kuk Innovation Party leader Shin Jang-sik said, "It keeps making me doubt whether they are sincerely thinking about solidarity and integration." The Democratic Party maintains that merger discussions have already begun, but the Cho Kuk Innovation Party says, "That is entirely untrue." (조국혁신당 조국 전 대표가 연일 이재명 정부와 더불어민주당을 비판하고 있다. 특히 이재명 대통령의 재판까지 언급하며 “유죄 가능성이 크다”고도 했다. 논란이 커지자 조 전 대표는 “이재명 정부 성공을 위한 ‘레드팀’ 역할”이라며 ‘충언’이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당에선 “합당 시동 국면에서 주도권을 쥐려는 의도로밖에 안 보인다”는 말이 나왔다.)

item.title: Kim Seung-won: "Process It Quickly"; Food and Drug Safety Minister: "I'll Take Care of It"... Clinical Trial Approved Two Weeks Later (김승원 “빨리 처리” 식약처장 “잘 챙기겠다”… 2주후 임상시험 승인)
item.description:
Claims that Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, was involved in lobbying related to a COVID-19 treatment in 2021 are spreading across the political sphere. On the 2nd, the opposition bloc alleged that Kim sent a text message to then-Food and Drug Safety Minister Kim Gang-rip saying, "Please make sure the working-level staff handle it quickly." The People Power Party stated, "Kim should stop tarnishing his own reputation and voluntarily step down." Kim's side responded, "Once the confirmation hearing preparation team is formed on the 3rd, we will gradually explain our position on the allegations." (김승원 법무부 장관 후보자가 2021년 코로나19 치료제 관련 로비에 연루됐다는 의혹을 규명해야 한다는 주장이 정치권에서 확산하고 있다. 2일 야권에선 김 후보자가 김강립 당시 식품의약품안전처장에게 “실무자들이 빠르게 처리할 수 있도록 부탁한다”는 문자메시지를 보냈다는 주장이 나왔다. 국민의힘은 “김 후보자는 더 이상 자신의 명예를 깎아 내리지 말고 자진 사퇴하라”고 했다. 김 후보자 측은 “3일 인사청문준비단이 구성되면 해당 의혹에 대한 입장도 차차 설명해 나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

The case began when Kang, a university professor who founded Pharmaceutical Company A, asked Yang, a female entrepreneur who was then a graduate student, in October 2021 to "help get (the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) approval quickly through connections in the political world." Company A was reportedly set to receive investment on the condition that the ministry approve its clinical trial plan. According to the indictment, Yang, who acted as a broker, asked Kim, then a first-term lawmaker of the Democratic Party, to "help Company A get its clinical trial plan approved quickly." Kim replied "OK" to Yang. (이 사건은 A 제약사를 설립한 대학교수 강모씨가 2021년 10월 대학원에 다니던 여성 기업인 양모씨에게 “정치권 인사를 통해 빨리 (식약처) 승인받을 수 있도록 해 달라”는 취지로 요청하면서 시작됐다. A사는 식약처 임상시험 계획 승인을 조건으로 투자를 받기로 한 상황이었다고 한다. 공소장에 따르면 브로커 역할을 한 양씨는 당시 민주당 초선 의원이던 김 후보자에게 “A사가 빨리 임상시험 계획 승인을 받도록 해달라”는 취지로 부탁했다. 김 후보자는 양씨에게 “오케”라고 답장했다.)

Kim, a former judge, had defended Yang in 2013 when he was a lawyer, handling her case involving violations of the Labor Standards Act at a bar she operated in Gangnam, Seoul. The circumstances of their first meeting are unknown. Yang reportedly established a cosmetics manufacturing company around 2014. (판사 출신인 김 후보자는 변호사였던 2013년 당시 서울 강남에서 유흥주점을 운영했던 양씨의 근로기준법 위반 사건 변호를 맡았다. 두 사람이 어떤 경로로 처음 만난 지는 알려지지 않았다. 양씨는 2014년 무렵 여성 화장품 제조 회사를 설립했다고 한다.)

After receiving the request from broker Yang, Kim called Food and Drug Safety Minister Kim Gang-rip and asked him to "take a good look into Company A's application for clinical trial approval for its COVID-19 treatment development." That same day, Yang also informed Kim of the relevant department within the ministry. Shortly thereafter, Kim reportedly sent another text message to Minister Kim saying, "The work is apparently divided among three offices within the ministry: the Herbal Medicine Division, the Clinical Trial Policy Division, and the Statistical Analysis Team. Please ask the working-level staff in charge to handle it as quickly as possible. The company is A." He relayed exactly what Yang had told him to Minister Kim. (김 후보자는 브로커 양씨 부탁을 받고 김강립 식약처장에게 전화해 “A사 코로나 치료제 개발 관련해서 임상시험 승인 신청을 했는데 잘 챙겨봐 달라”는 취지로 요청했다. 같은 날 양씨는 김 후보자에게 식약처 담당 부서를 알려주기도 했다. 이 직후 김 후보자는 김 처장에게 “(식약처 내에) 생약제제과, 임상제도과, 통계분석팀 3군데에서 업무 분장이 되어 있답니다. 담당 실무자들이 좀 빠르게 처리할 수 있도록 부탁 드린다. 회사는 A입니다”라는 문자메시지도 보냈다고 한다. 양씨가 일러준 그대로 김 처장에게 전달한 것이다.)

Minister Kim replied to Kim, "Lawmaker, I have passed on your concerns to the working-level staff to make sure they are handled properly." Kim then forwarded the minister's text message to Yang. (김 처장은 김 후보자에게 “의원님, 염려해주신 건은 잘 챙기도록 실무진에게 전달했다”고 답장했다. 김 후보자는 이 같은 식약처장의 문자메시지를 양씨에게 재전송했다.)

Two days before the ministry approved Company A's clinical trial plan, Yang sent a text message referencing the approval status and said, "We definitely need to make sure big brother (presumed to mean 'hyung') gets credit for helping." Kim replied, "Yeah yeah, of course, we have to prevent the outflow of national wealth." The ministry approved Company A's clinical trial plan on October 26, 2021, two weeks after Kim had called the minister. (양씨는 식약처가 A사 임상시험 계획을 승인하기 이틀 전 문자메시지로 식약처 승인 상황을 언급하며 “엉아(형이라는 뜻으로 추정)가 힘 보탠 거 확실히 해야죠”라고 했고, 김 후보자는 “응응 그럼, 국부 유출 막아야지”라고 답했다. 식약처는 김 후보자가 식약처장에게 전화를 한 지 2주 후인 2021년 10월 26일 A사 임상시험 계획을 승인했다.)

In December of that year, Yang sent an email to Kang, the founder of Company A who had requested the lobbying, asking, "Please make a donation of 5 million won to Lawmaker Kim Seung-won, who worked hard on the approval matter." She also wrote, "He's in the Lee Jae-myung line (presumed to mean 'oppa'), but since I haven't repaid him, it's hard to ask again." Yang asked Kim for his donation account number, and Kim provided it, saying "Thanks." According to the prosecution's investigation, Kang attempted to transfer 5 million won to Kim's donation account on December 31, but the transfer was not actually completed because the annual donation limit had been reached. However, Yang was known to have testified during the trial that "Kim declined, saying he would accept only the sentiment." (그해 12월 양씨는 로비를 요청했던 A사 창업자 강씨에게 “승인 건으로 힘써주신 김승원 의원님께 500만원 후원금을 부탁드린다”는 이메일을 보냈다. 또 “이재명 라인은 옵(오빠라는 뜻으로 추정)인데 보답을 못 해 다시 부탁하긴 그렇고요”라고도 했다. 양씨는 김 후보자에게 후원금 계좌 번호를 물었고, 김 후보자는 “고마워”라면서 알려주기도 했다. 강씨는 12월 31일 김 후보자 후원금 계좌로 500만원 송금을 하려 했으나 연간 후원금 한도액이 차서 실제 송금이 이뤄지지 않았다는 게 검찰 수사 결과다. 다만 양씨는 재판 과정에서 “김 후보자가 마음만 받겠다고 거절했다”는 취지로 진술한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Kang, the founder of Company A, was indicted in December 2024 on charges of breach of trust, obstruction of business, and attempted fraud for allegedly applying for clinical approval from the ministry after deleting cases of side effects in animal testing, and was sentenced in the first trial to three years in prison, suspended for five years. However, the court at the time acquitted him on some charges, stating, "No explicit promise of payment in exchange for the lobbying was found, and it is difficult to conclude that (Kang) requested that the ministry's approval review process be skipped or expedited." The prosecution subsequently added charges of "promising to provide bribes" against Yang and Kang, and a first-instance trial is currently underway at the Seoul Western District Court. (A사 창업자 강씨는 동물 실험 부작용 사례를 삭제한 채 식약처에 임상 승인을 신청했다는 등의 혐의로 2024년 12월 배임·업무방해·사기 미수 혐의 등으로 재판에 넘겨져 1심에서 징역 3년에 집행유예 5년을 선고받았다. 다만 당시 재판부는 “(강씨가) 양씨에게 청탁 알선 대가를 명시적으로 약속한 내용은 발견되지 않았고, 식약처 승인 심사 절차를 생략하거나 우선적으로 심사해 달라는 청탁을 했다고 단정하기는 어렵다”며 일부 혐의에 대해 무죄를 선고했다. 검찰은 이후 ‘뇌물 공여 약속’ 혐의로 양씨·강씨를 추가 기소해 현재 서울서부지법에서 1심 재판이 진행 중이다.)

Kim received a deferred indictment from the prosecution in December 2024. A deferred indictment is a disposition in which charges are acknowledged but prosecution is postponed. In a text message sent the previous day to Seo Young-kyo, the Democratic Party lawmaker who chairs the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, Kim said, "Despite an investigation involving 11 prosecutors over three years, there was no direct evidence of the 5 million won promise, and there was no actual preferential treatment either." (김 후보자는 2024년 12월 검찰에서 기소유예 처분을 받았다. 기소유예는 혐의가 인정되지만 공소 제기를 미루는 처분이다. 김 후보자는 전날 민주당 소속인 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장에게 보낸 문자메시지에서 “3년간 검사 11명을 투입해 수사했지만 500만원 약속의 직접 증거도 없고 실제 특혜도 없었다”고 했다.)

Chairman Seo wrote on Facebook that day, "After digging through everything, they found nothing and should have dropped the case as having no charges, but instead they brazenly handed Kim Seung-won a deferred indictment. Isn't the person who should apologize to nominee Kim none other than then-Minister of Justice Han Dong-hoon?" In response, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who raised the lobbying allegations, said, "Chairman Seo should not interfere without knowing the facts and should let Kim directly answer whether he sent the lobbying text message to the food and drug safety minister." (서 위원장은 이날 페이스북에 “(검찰이) 다 뒤져도 내용이 없어서 무혐의로 손을 떼야 하는데 적반하장으로 김승원 의원을 기소유예한 사건”이라며 “김승원 후보에게 미안하다고 사과해야 할 사람이 한동훈 당시 법무부 장관 아니냐”고 했다. 그러자 로비 의혹을 제기한 무소속 한동훈 의원은 “서 위원장은 잘 모르면서 끼어들지 말고, 김 후보자가 식약처장에게 청탁 문자를 보냈는지 직접 답하게 두시라”고 했다.)

item.title: "Kim Seong-su, 43-Pyeong Gangnam Apartment at 350 Million Won Jeonse... Suspicion of Gift Tax Evasion" (“김성수, 43평 강남 아파트를 3억5000만원에 전세… 증여세 탈루 의혹”)
item.description:
Supreme Court Justice nominee Kim Seong-su has been confirmed as of the 2nd to have lived long-term in a Gangnam, Seoul apartment at 350 million won—significantly below market value—through a 'sublease' arrangement in which he re-rented a property his brother-in-law had leased. The People Power Party has raised suspicions of gift tax evasion against Kim. (김성수 대법관 후보자가 처남이 빌린 집을 다시 빌리는 ‘전대차’ 방식으로 서울 강남 아파트에 시세보다 현저히 낮은 3억5000만원에 장기 거주한 것으로 2일 확인됐다. 국민의힘은 김 후보자의 증여세 탈루 의혹을 제기했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo held a press conference that day, stating that Kim resides in a 43-pyeong unit (exclusive area 120㎡) at Dogok-raexel, a large apartment complex in Dogok-dong, Gangnam, Seoul, with a deposit of 350 million won and monthly rent of 800,000 won. The current jeonse market value for Dogok-raexel is around 1.95 billion won. Kim's brother-in-law had signed a jeonse contract with the owner for 1.5225 billion won and then subleased the property to Kim. The brother-in-law is a former head of a famous gaming company. (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 이날 기자회견을 열고 김 후보자가 서울 강남 도곡동 대단지 아파트 도곡렉슬 43평형(전용면적 120㎡)에 보증금 3억5000만원, 월세 80만원에 거주하고 있다고 밝혔다. 도곡렉슬 현재 전세 시세는 19억5000만원 수준이다. 김 후보자 처남이 집주인으로부터 15억2250만원에 전세 계약을 맺은 다음, 김 후보자에게 다시 전세를 준 것이다. 처남은 유명 게임업체 대표 출신이다.)

Before moving to Dogok-raexel in June 2021, Kim lived for ten years in a 24-pyeong unit (exclusive area 59㎡) at Yeoksam e-Pyunhansesang apartment in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam, owned by his brother-in-law. According to the asset declarations Kim submitted dating from 2018 onward, his lease deposit remained consistently at 350 million won. Between 2018 and 2021, the jeonse market value for Yeoksam e-Pyunhansesang ranged from 700 million to 1.1 billion won. Lawmaker Joo stated, "I hope Kim pays the evaded taxes and decides his own fate." If one leases at a deposit significantly below market value, the difference is deemed a gratuitous gift and becomes subject to gift tax. (김 후보자는 2021년 6월 도곡렉슬로 이사하기 전에는 처남이 소유한 서울 강남 역삼동 역삼e편한세상 아파트 24평형(전용 59㎡)에서 10년간 살았다. 김 후보자가 제출한 2018년 이후 재산신고 내역을 보면 김 후보자의 임차보증금은 줄곧 3억5000만원이었다. 2018~2021년 역삼e편한세상의 전세 시세는 7억~11억원 수준이었다. 주 의원은 “김 후보자는 탈루한 세금을 납부하고, 스스로 거취를 결정하기 바란다”고 했다. 시세보다 현저하게 저렴한 보증금으로 임차하면 그 차액만큼 무상으로 증여받은 것으로 간주돼 증여세 부과 대상이 된다.)

Kim's side explained, "At the urging of his mother-in-law, who was concerned about his unmarried brother-in-law, in 2021 the nominee's family and the brother-in-law moved into the apartment together." The argument is that because Kim's family lived in the same household as the brother-in-law, it was not a preferential transaction. Regarding the 350 million won deposit for Dogok-raexel, they said, "That deposit was originally paid to the brother-in-law in 2011 when leasing the Yeoksam e-Pyunhansesang property he owned. When we moved together to Dogok-raexel in 2021, it was not returned but used as part of the lease deposit for that apartment, which is why it was declared as that amount." They added, "However, Kim is aware that there may be tax issues in this process, and once the confirmation hearing procedure concludes, he plans to resolve them through appropriate means." Lawmaker Joo countered, "It is hard to accept the explanation that a brother-in-law who earned over 10 billion won in annual salary as the head of a game company lived together with his sister's family." (김 후보자 측은 “미혼인 처남을 염려한 장모의 권유로 2021년 후보자 가족과 처남이 함께 해당 아파트에 이사하게 됐다”고 했다. 김 후보자 가족이 처남과 한집에 같이 살았기 때문에 특혜 거래가 아니라는 취지다. 도곡렉슬 임차보증금 3억5000만원에 대해서는 “2011년 처남 소유 역삼e편한세상 임차 당시 처남에게 지급한 보증금으로, 2021년 도곡렉슬로 함께 이사하면서도 돌려받지 않고 해당 아파트의 임차보증금 중 일부로 사용됐기 때문에 해당 금액으로 재산신고한 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “다만 이 과정에서 세무상 쟁점이 있을 수 있다는 점은 김 후보자도 인지하고 있으며, 인사청문회 절차가 마무리되는 대로 적정한 방법으로 정리할 예정”이라고 했다. 주 의원은 “게임 회사 대표를 지내며 100억원 넘는 연봉을 받던 처남이 누나네와 같이 살았다는 해명은 납득하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

Kim declared ownership of a 2008 Hyundai Grandeur in his asset report, and it is known that the vehicle's windshield bears a sticker provided to department store VIP customers. The VIP tier indicated on Kim's vehicle typically requires annual purchases of at least 20 million won and offers benefits such as valet parking and free parking at the department store. Kim's declared assets, including those of himself, his spouse, children, and mother, total approximately 580 million won. (김 후보자는 재산신고에서 2008년식 그랜저 승용차를 보유하고 있다고 밝혔는데, 이 차량 앞유리에는 백화점 VIP 고객에게 제공되는 스티커가 부착돼 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 김 후보자 차량에 표시된 VIP 등급은 연간 2000만원 이상 구매해야 선정될 수 있고, 백화점 발렛파킹과 무료 주차 등의 혜택이 주어진다. 김 후보자가 신고한 재산은 본인과 배우자, 자녀, 모친을 포함해 총 5억8000만원가량이다.)

item.title: From Its Founding, a "Yong Hye-in Couple's Party"... After a Meeting of Just the Two of Them, Her Husband Became Secretary-General (창당 때부터 ‘용혜인 부부당’… 둘만의 회의 뒤 남편 사무총장 됐다)
item.description:
Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, was found to have appointed her husband, Park Ki-hong (pictured), as Secretary-General during a party meeting held three days after the founding of the Basic Income Party. The records show that only she and her husband attended the relevant meeting. Park has continued to hold key party positions since then and is currently running as a candidate in the party's supreme council election. The People Power Party is demanding the withdrawal of Yong's nomination, calling it "not the Basic Income Party but the Family Income Party." (용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자가 기본소득당 창당 3일 후 열린 당 회의에서 남편 박기홍<사진>씨를 사무총장에 임명한 것으로 나타났다. 관련 회의에는 본인과 남편만 참석한 것으로 기재됐다. 박씨는 이후에도 당의 핵심 보직을 맡아왔으며, 현재는 당 최고위원 선거에도 후보자로 출마한 상태다. 국민의힘은 “기본소득당이 아니라 가족소득당”이라며 용 후보자의 지명철회를 요구하고 있다.)

According to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Cho Ji-yeon on the 2nd, Yong founded the Basic Income Party on January 19, 2020, and at the first standing committee meeting held three days later, she appointed her husband, Park, as party Secretary-General in her capacity as standing chairperson. According to the "meeting results notice" posted on the Basic Income Party's website, the only attendee was Yong herself, and the only observer was her husband, Park. The Basic Income Party typically recorded the list of attendees and observers in most meeting result notices, and cases with only two people were rare. A Basic Income Party official told the press, "Immediately after the party's founding, Yong was the only one with standing committee qualifications, and as a minor party without parliamentary seats, it was an unavoidable approach. There are no issues with the party constitution, rules, or procedures," adding, "Park's presence as an observer on the day of the Secretary-General appointment was customary, as with other parties." (2일 조지연 국민의힘 의원실에 따르면, 용 후보자는 2020년 1월 19일 기본소득당을 창당하고 3일 뒤 열린 1차 상무위원회 회의에서 상임대표 자격으로 남편 박씨를 당 사무총장에 임명했다. 기본소득당 홈페이지에 공개된 이날 ‘회의 결과 공지’를 보면, 회의 참석자는 용 후보자, 참관인은 남편 박씨뿐이었다. 기본소득당은 대부분의 회의 결과 공지에 참석자, 참관인 명단을 기록했는데, 2명뿐인 경우는 드물다. 기본소득당 관계자는 언론에 “창당 직후 상무위원 자격은 용 후보자뿐이었고, 원외 소수정당으로서 불가피한 방식이었다. 당헌·당규 및 절차상 문제는 없다”며 “사무총장 임명 당일 박씨가 참관한 것은 다른 정당과 마찬가지로 관례적인 것”이라고 전했다.)

The ratification of her husband Park's appointment took place at the second meeting held on February 1, 2020, with the Yong couple in attendance. According to the meeting results, attendees at the time included regional committee members from seven areas—Seoul, Gyeonggi, Daejeon, Gwangju, and North Jeolla—along with the Yong couple, totaling nine people. There were also five observers. About two months after his appointment as Secretary-General, Park went on to serve as acting standing chairperson. This was because Yong stepped down from the standing chairperson position in March 2020 to run as a proportional representation candidate for the joint opposition party "Together Citizens' Party." Since then, Park has held major party positions including head of the Strategic Planning Office and head of the Planning and Coordination Office, and currently serves as Deputy Head of Strategic Planning. Regarding this newspaper's inquiry about the appointment of her husband Park as Secretary-General and its procedures, the preparation team for the Gender Equality Ministry confirmation hearing stated, "It was immediately after the founding of a minor party without parliamentary seats, and the appointment was made through internal recommendation and deliberation processes." (남편 박씨의 임명에 대한 인준은 2020년 2월 1일 진행된 두번째 회의에서 용 후보자 부부가 참석한 가운데 진행됐다. 회의 결과를 보면 당시 참석자는 서울, 경기, 대전, 광주, 전북 등 7개 지역 위원들과 용 후보자 부부 등 총 9명이었다. 참관인도 5명 있었다. 이후 박씨는 사무총장에 임명된 지 두 달여 만에 상임대표 권한대행까지 맡았다. 용 후보자가 2020년 3월 비례연합정당 ‘더불어시민당’의 비례대표 후보자 출마를 위해 상임대표직에서 사퇴했기 때문이다. 이후로 박씨는 기본소득당 전략기획실장, 기획조정실장 등 주요 당직을 지냈고 현재 전략기획부총장으로 있다. 성평등부 인사청문회 준비단 측은 남편 박씨의 사무총장 임명과 절차에 대한 본지 질의에 “원외 소수정당으로 창당한 직후로 당내 추천과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 임명한 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

According to the Basic Income Party's 2026 accounting report, Yong's husband Park received a monthly salary of around 3 million won as a party official. Yong, as a National Assembly member, received approximately 13 million won per month in parliamentary salaries from the state, while her husband received a monthly wage from the party funded by government subsidies and donations. Park received a base salary of between 2.96 million and 3.07 million won on the 20th of each month, and even received an 800,000 won bonus during the Lunar New Year holiday last February. His salary level was among the highest of full-time party staff. The People Power Party criticized, "Yong cannot give up her proportional representation seat because of the approximately 1.1 billion won in annual government subsidies and her husband's monthly salary." (기본소득당 2026년도 회계보고서에 따르면 용 후보자 남편 박씨는 당직자로서 매달 300만원 정도의 급여를 받은 것으로 확인됐다. 용 후보자는 국회의원으로서 매월 약 1300만원의 세비를 국가로부터 받았고, 남편은 국고보조금과 후원금 등을 통해 당으로부터 월급을 챙겨온 셈이다. 박씨는 매월 20일 급여일마다 296만~307만원의 기본급을 받았으며 지난 2월 설 명절에는 80만원의 상여금까지 챙겼다. 월급 수준은 상근 당직자 중 상위권이었다. 국민의힘은 “용 후보자가 연간 국고보조금 약 11억원과 남편 월급 등 때문에 비례대표 의원직을 포기하지 못하는 것”이라고 비판했다.)

Most of the Basic Income Party's expenditures were found to be concentrated on personnel costs and organizational activity expenses. According to the 2025 accounting report, total expenditures were 1.35 billion won, with personnel costs at 631.58 million won and organizational activity expenses at 124.04 million won. Policy development costs were only 47.38 million won, while women's political development and youth political development funds were a mere 6.49 million won and 5.04 million won, respectively. (기본소득당의 대부분의 지출은 인건비와 조직활동비에 치우친 것으로 나타났다. 2025년 회계보고서에 따르면, 지출액은 총 13억5039만원인데, 인건비가 6억3158만원, 조직활동비가 1억2404만원이었다. 정책개발비는 4738만원, 여성정치발전비와 청년정치발전비는 각각 649만원, 504만원에 그쳤다.)

The opposition also pointed out that a significant number of Yong's legislative office staff were filled by individuals who had held major positions in the Basic Income Party. At least 5 out of 9 staff members had served as party officials or regional chairpersons in the Basic Income Party. Among them were two sisters—the chief of staff for the representative's office and a senior secretary—who had both run unsuccessfully as proportional representation candidates in the 2022 local elections for the Busan Metropolitan Council and the Gyeonggi Provincial Council, respectively. The list of Yong's office staff has also unusually not been disclosed on the National Assembly website. Yong's side stated, "Movement between party positions and legislative staff is particularly common in progressive parties." The People Power Party criticized, "The operation of a public party has been tainted by private interests." (야권은 용 후보자 의원실 보좌진 상당수가 기본소득당 주요 당직을 거친 인사들로 채워졌다는 점도 지적했다. 보좌진 9명 가운데 최소 5명이 기본소득당 당직 또는 지역위원장을 지냈다. 이들 중에는 자매 사이도 있었다. 대표실 비서실장과 선임비서관인데, 두 사람은 2022년 지방선거에서 각각 부산시의회 비례대표로, 경기도의회 비례대표로 출마했다가 낙선한 경력이 있다. 용 후보자 보좌진 명단은 국회 홈페이지에도 이례적으로 공개돼 있지 않다. 용 후보자 측은 “당직과 원내 인사 간 이동은 특히 진보정당에선 일반적 사안”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 “공적인 정당 운영이 사적인 이해관계로 얼룩졌다”고 비판했다.)

On the same day, a civic group also filed a complaint with the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency against Yong, alleging abuse of authority and violation of the Public Official Election Act for using the VIP lounge at Gimpo Airport during a past family trip. The operational rules of the Korea Airports Corporation's VIP lounge stipulate that it may only be used during official duties. (이날 한 시민단체는 용 후보자가 과거 자신의 가족여행 때 김포공항 귀빈실을 이용했다며 직권남용과 공직선거법 위반 등 혐의로 서울경찰청에 고발하기도 했다. 한국공항공사 귀빈실 운영 예규는 귀빈실은 공무 수행 중에만 이용할 수 있다고 명시해두고 있다.)

item.title: "Meteoric Rise, Double and Triple Privileges" — Skepticism Over Yong Hye-in Even Within the Ruling Party (“벼락 출세, 이중삼중 특혜” 여당서도 용혜인 회의론)
item.description:
The parliamentary confirmation hearing process for the second-term cabinet nominees of the Lee Jae-myung administration has officially begun. The People Power Party has set its sights on forcing out Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice who has called for the dismissal of President Lee Jae-myung's indictment, and Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family who served twice as a proportional representation lawmaker under the Democratic Party's satellite party. Even within the Democratic Party, skepticism has emerged over Yong, with criticism of her "meteoric rise, privileges, and image of unfairness." Progressive-leaning parties within the broader ruling bloc, including the Justice Party, the Green Party, and the Labor Party, have also called one after another for the withdrawal of Yong's nomination. (이재명 정부 2기 내각 후보자들에 대한 국회 인사청문 정국이 본격 시작됐다. 국민의힘은 이재명 대통령의 공소취소를 외쳐온 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자, 더불어민주당 위성정당으로 비례대표 국회의원을 두번 지낸 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자를 낙마 대상에 올렸다. 민주당에서도 용 후보자에 대해선 “벼락출세, 특혜, 불공정 이미지”라며 회의론이 나왔다. 정의당, 녹색당, 노동당 등 범여권 정당들도 줄줄이 용 후보자의 지명 철회를 요구했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil said on SBS Radio on the 2nd regarding President Lee Jae-myung's nomination of Yong, "It won't be easy for public sentiment to accept this." He added, "Isn't this a sudden meteoric rise with double and triple privileges?" and "Is this really fair? There are questions about what appeal this has for people in their 20s and 30s." (민주당 송영길 의원은 2일 SBS 라디오에서 이재명 대통령의 용 후보자 지명에 대해 “민심이 수용하기 쉽지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “갑자기 벼락 출세하고 특혜를 이중 삼중으로 받은 것이지 않나”라며 “과연 이게 공정한가. 2030에게 무슨 소구력이 있을까에 대한 의문이 있다”고 했다.)

Criticism has also continued over Yong's statement that she would not give up her proportional representation seat even if appointed as a minister. Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Kwang-jae said on MBC News the same day, "If you want to be a minister, resigning your parliamentary seat would be the youthful thing to do," and "The overall mood within the party leans that way." (용 후보자가 장관직에 임명돼도 비례대표직을 내려놓지 않겠다고 밝힌 것에 대한 비판도 이어졌다. 민주당 이광재 의원은 이날 MBC 뉴스에서 “장관을 하고 싶으면 국회의원직을 사퇴하는 게 청년다운 모습”이라며 “당내 분위기도 전체적으로 그렇다”고 했다.)

However, Yong avoided answering on the same day when asked about demands to resign her proportional representation seat, saying only, "There are various opinions." Regarding the various allegations, she also said only, "I am well aware that there is much worry and concern. I will listen and listen again. I will prepare thoroughly for the hearing." (하지만 용 후보자는 이날 비례대표 의원직 사퇴 요구에 대해 “여러 의견이 있다”며 답변을 피했다. 각종 의혹에 대해서도 “많은 걱정과 우려가 있다는 것을 잘 알고 있다”며 “제가 듣고 또 듣겠다. 청문회를 잘 준비하겠다”고만 했다.)

◇ Labor Party, Green Party, and Justice Party: "Withdraw the Minister Nomination" (◇노동당·녹색당·정의당 “장관 후보 지명 철회를”)

Within the Democratic Party, arguments have been made about Yong such as, "Giving up the proportional representation seat would meet public expectations (Lawmaker Kim Young-bae)" and "The controversy over holding dual offices has tarnished the meaning of unity and expansion in the cabinet reshuffle (Lawmaker Chae Hyun-il)." (민주당 내에선 용 후보자에 대해 “비례대표 국회의원직을 던지는 게 국민 눈높이에 맞다(김영배 의원)” “겸직 논란으로 개각의 통합과 확장 의미가 퇴색했다(채현일 의원)” 등의 주장이 나왔다.)

The Labor Party, Green Party, and Justice Party also issued a joint statement the same day, demanding, "President Lee Jae-myung must withdraw Yong's nomination as Minister of Gender Equality and Family," calling it "an inappropriate appointment that solidifies the politics of expedient satellite parties." These parties had joined hands with Yong's Basic Income Party in 2021 to announce a "Joint Political Declaration Against Entrenched Privileges," but they split in 2024 over the issue of forming a satellite party. They view the Basic Income Party's participation in the satellite party as having further entrenched the two-party establishment system of the Democratic Party and the People Power Party. In a commentary the same day, the Green Party said, "The behavior of trying to cling to both a parliamentary seat and a ministerial post to protect a seat obtained through underhanded means sets yet another bad precedent in Korean political history." (노동당·녹색당·정의당도 이날 공동성명을 내고 “이재명 대통령은 용 후보자의 성평등가족부 장관 지명 철회하라”며 “편법 위성정당 정치를 공고히 하는 부적절한 인사”라고 했다. 이들 정당은 2021년 용 후보자의 기본소득당과 손잡고 ‘반기득권 공동정치선언’을 발표했지만 2024년 위성정당 창당 문제로 갈라섰다. 이들은 기본소득당의 위성정당 참여로 민주당과 국민의힘 등 양당 기득권 체제가 더 굳어졌다고 보고 있다. 녹색당은 이날 논평에서 “편법으로 얻은 의석을 지키기 위해 의원직과 장관직을 모두 움켜쥐려는 행태는 한국 정치사에 또 하나의 나쁜 선례를 남기는 일”이라고 했다.)

The presidential office is said to have been taken aback when not only women's groups but also minor progressive parties demanded the withdrawal of the nomination. A key official in the ruling camp said, "They seem to have not anticipated this level of backlash." Although the presidential office officially denied it, it is known that concerns were conveyed to Yong, along with the suggestion that it would be better for her to resign her proportional representation seat after being appointed as minister. (청와대는 여성단체뿐 아니라 진보 성향의 소수 정당까지 지명 철회를 요구하자 당황한 것으로 알려졌다. 여권 핵심 관계자는 “이 정도 반발은 예상하지 못한 것 같다”고 했다. 청와대는 공식적으론 부인했지만, 용 후보자에게 우려를 전달하며 장관직 임명 이후 비례 의원직을 사퇴하는 게 좋겠다는 의견을 전달한 것으로 알려졌다.)

On the same day, ruling and opposition parties tentatively agreed to hold confirmation hearings on the 15th for Lee Hyung-il, nominee for Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance, and Lee So-young, nominee for Minister of SMEs and Startups. They also agreed to hold hearings on the 16th for Kang Shin-chul, nominee for Minister of National Defense, and Hong Ji-sun, nominee for Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport. The Democratic Party has stated its intention to complete hearings for Kim Seung-won, nominee for Minister of Justice, and Yong before the Chuseok holiday (the 24th). Meanwhile, according to a survey conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) from the 31st to the 1st targeting 1,000 people aged 18 and older nationwide, 37.7% viewed President Lee's reshuffle of six ministries positively, while 46.6% viewed it negatively. (이날 여야는 오는 15일 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관 후보자, 이소영 중소벤처기업부 장관 후보자에 대한 인사청문회를 진행키로 잠정 합의했다. 또 강신철 국방부·홍지선 국토교통부 장관 후보자에 대한 청문회는 16일 진행하기로 했다. 민주당은 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자와 용 후보자 청문회도 추석 연휴(24일) 전 끝내겠다는 입장이다. 이런 가운데 한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)가 지난달 31일부터 1일까지 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 한 조사에 따르면 이 대통령의 6개 부처 개각에 대해 긍정 전망 37.7%, 부정 전망 46.6%로 집계됐다.)
